title: Karen and Game
statementMd:
On the way to school, Karen became fixated on the puzzle game on her phone!

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ddb523e5319d3e419119c3679bdc76340ed480e8.png)

The game is played as follows. In each level, you have a grid with $*n*$ rows and $*m*$ columns. Each cell originally contains the number $0$.

One move consists of choosing one row or column, and adding $1$ to all of the cells in that row or column.

To win the level, after all the moves, the number in the cell at the $*i*$-th row and $*j*$-th column should be equal to $*g*_{*i*, *j*}$.

Karen is stuck on one level, and wants to know a way to beat this level using the minimum number of moves. Please, help her with this task!

## Input

The first line of input contains two integers, $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 100$), the number of rows and the number of columns in the grid, respectively.

The next $*n*$ lines each contain $*m*$ integers. In particular, the $*j*$-th integer in the $*i*$-th of these rows contains $*g*_{*i*, *j*}$ ($0 ≤ *g*_{*i*, *j*} ≤ 500$).

## Output

If there is an error and it is actually not possible to beat the level, output a single integer `-1`.

Otherwise, on the first line, output a single integer $*k*$, the minimum number of moves necessary to beat the level.

The next $*k*$ lines should each contain one of the following, describing the moves in the order they must be done:

- `row` $*x*$, ($1 ≤ *x* ≤ *n*$) describing a move of the form "choose the $*x*$-th row".
- `col` $*x*$, ($1 ≤ *x* ≤ *m*$) describing a move of the form "choose the $*x*$-th column".

If there are multiple optimal solutions, output any one of them.

## Note

In the first test case, Karen has a grid with $3$ rows and $5$ columns. She can perform the following $4$ moves to beat the level:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9725553e228c387c0f12702a054f3a965a7b0805.png)

In the second test case, Karen has a grid with $3$ rows and $3$ columns. It is clear that it is impossible to beat the level; performing any move will create three $1$s on the grid, but it is required to only have one $1$ in the center.

In the third test case, Karen has a grid with $3$ rows and $3$ columns. She can perform the following $3$ moves to beat the level:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fd3281c5d83a863405f380c56f861f780a802d8c.png)

Note that this is not the only solution; another solution, among others, is `col 1`, `col 2`, `col 3`.
statementZhMd:
上学途中，Karen 沉迷于手机上的益智游戏！

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ddb523e5319d3e419119c3679bdc76340ed480e8.png)

游戏规则如下。每个关卡中，你有一个 $*n*$ 行 $*m*$ 列的网格。每个单元格初始都包含数字 $0$。

一次操作可以选择一行或一列，并将该行或该列中的所有单元格都加上 $1$。

要通过关卡，在执行完所有操作后，第 $*i*$ 行第 $*j*$ 列的单元格中的数字必须等于 $*g*_{*i*, *j*}$。

Karen 卡在了其中一个关卡上，她想知道如何用最少的操作次数通过该关卡。请帮助她完成这个任务！

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 100$），分别表示网格的行数和列数。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含 $*m*$ 个整数。其中，这些行中的第 $*i*$ 行的第 $*j*$ 个整数表示 $*g*_{*i*, *j*}$（$0 ≤ *g*_{*i*, *j*} ≤ 500$）。

## 输出格式

如果无法通过该关卡，输出一个整数 `-1`。

否则，第一行输出一个整数 $*k*$，表示通过该关卡所需的最少操作次数。

接下来的 $*k*$ 行应按照操作执行的顺序，每行描述以下操作中的一种：

- `row` $*x*$，（$1 ≤ *x* ≤ *n*$）表示选择第 $*x*$ 行。
- `col` $*x*$，（$1 ≤ *x* ≤ *m*$）表示选择第 $*x*$ 列。

如果有多个最优解，输出任意一个即可。

## 说明

在第一个测试用例中，Karen 有一个 $3$ 行 $5$ 列的网格。她可以执行以下 $4$ 次操作来通过关卡：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9725553e228c387c0f12702a054f3a965a7b0805.png)

在第二个测试用例中，Karen 有一个 $3$ 行 $3$ 列的网格。显然无法通过该关卡；执行任意一次操作都会在网格中产生三个 $1$，但要求只有中心位置为 $1$。

在第三个测试用例中，Karen 有一个 $3$ 行 $3$ 列的网格。她可以执行以下 $3$ 次操作来通过关卡：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fd3281c5d83a863405f380c56f861f780a802d8c.png)

注意，这并不是唯一的解；其他解还包括 `col 1`、`col 2`、`col 3`。
